retained_hcu_lane.scope_limit_observed: pre-load artifact hashing does not itself prove that a later model loader consumed the same bytes

track_a.name: ENTITYOS_EXECUTABLE_CONVERGENCE
track_a.delta: tighten runtime acceptance so positive EngineAdmission receives zero runtime credit unless actual loader consumption is bound to the admitted artifact identity

track_b.name: HCU_AND_TYPED_ENTRY_FABRIC_CO_DEVELOPMENT
track_b.delta: define the physical HCU model lease boundary as loader-bound rather than pre-load-hash-bound; causal Entry/route identity remains separate from physical consumed-byte evidence

hypothesis: A pre-load checkpoint/tokenizer/runtime/build digest is insufficient to establish the physical HCU engine actually consumed those admitted bytes because path contents can change after verification and before loading.
counterhypothesis: Hashing exact local artifact bytes immediately before routing is operationally sufficient; later loader consumption can be treated as identical without another binding mechanism.

unusual_experiment.name: PRELOAD_HASH_THEN_PATH_MUTATION_VS_VERIFIED_SNAPSHOT_LOAD
method: construct one checkpoint directory containing model.safetensors=weights-A
compute the retained EngineAdmission tree-digest algorithm identity
condition A: mutate the original path to weights-B after admission and then simulate loader read from the original path
condition B: reset to weights-A, verify, copy to a separate staged snapshot, mutate only the original path to weights-B, then simulate loader read from the staged snapshot

result.finding: pre-load admission identity and actual loader-consumed bytes are distinct evidence boundaries
result.counterfactual_support: content-addressed staging prevents mutation of the original source path from silently changing bytes loaded from the staged copy
result.remaining_limit: a normal writable staging directory is not itself an immutable loader attestation; same-user staging mutation or a loader choosing another path remains possible
